<style>
:root {
  --font-serif: 'Fraunces', 'Cormorant', 'Playfair Display', serif;
  --font-sans: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --color-bg: #FAF7F2;
  --color-surface: #FFFFFF;
  --color-text-primary: #1F1611;
  --color-text-secondary: #6B5D52;
  --color-accent: #B8860B;
  --color-border: rgba(31,22,17,0.1);
  --color-header-bg: rgba(250,247,242,0.94);
  --color-footer-bg: #1F1611;
  --radius-sm: 6px;
  --radius-md: 12px;
  --radius-lg: 32px;
  --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(31,22,17,0.06);
  --shadow-md: 0 12px 36px rgba(31,22,17,0.1);
  --max-width: 1200px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{height:100%;overflow-x:hidden}
body{font-family:var(--font-sans);background:var(--color-bg);color:var(--color-text-primary);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;line-height:1.5}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--font-serif);color:var(--color-text-primary);letter-spacing:-0.01em}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.container{max-width:var(--max-width);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1rem}
/* Header */
.site-header{background:var(--color-header-bg);backdrop-filter:saturate(120%) blur(4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50}
.header-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;max-width:var(--max-width);margin:0 auto;padding:14px 1rem}
.brand{font-family:var(--font-serif);font-weight:700;font-size:1.125rem;color:var(--color-text-primary)}
.primary-nav{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center}
.primary-nav a{font-size:0.98rem;color:var(--color-text-secondary);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px;min-height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center}
.primary-nav a:hover{color:var(--color-text-primary)}
.header-cta .btn-reserve{background:var(--color-accent);color:#fff;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.header-cta .btn-reserve:hover{opacity:0.95}
/* Bottom Navigation – visible on mobile */
.bottom-nav{display:none;position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;width:100%;background:var(--color-footer-bg);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);z-index:60;justify-content:space-around;padding:6px 0}
.bottom-nav .nav-item{color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:44px;min-width:44px;text-align:center}
.bottom-nav .nav-item .icon{font-size:1.2rem}
/* Footer */
.site-footer{background:var(--color-footer-bg);color:#fff;padding:40px 1rem}
.footer-inner{display:flex;gap:28px;max-width:var(--max-width);margin:0 auto;padding-bottom:18px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)}
.footer-col{flex:1;min-width:180px}
.footer-col h4{font-family:var(--font-serif);margin-bottom:8px}
.footer-col a{color:#fff;text-decoration:underline}
.footer-social a{display:inline-block;margin-right:8px;color:#fff}
.footer-bottom{max-width:var(--max-width);margin:18px auto 0;padding-top:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.footer-brand{font-family:var(--font-serif);font-weight:700}
.footer-copy{font-size:0.9rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.72)}
/* Utilities */
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--color-accent);color:#fff}
.card{background:var(--color-surface);border:1px solid var(--color-border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);overflow:hidden}
.grid{display:grid;gap:16px}
.grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
/* Responsive Breakpoints */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .primary-nav{display:none}
  .bottom-nav{display:flex}
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .grid-3{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .header-inner{padding:12px 1rem}
}
@media (max-width: 375px) {
  .container{padding:0 .5rem}
  .primary-nav a{font-size:0.9rem}
}
@media (max-width: 320px) {
  .brand{font-size:1rem}
  .header-cta .btn-reserve{font-size:0.9rem;padding:8px 12px}
}
</style>
